038b10af6d03.en: She bit her cheeks, and approached the white fire. Touching its border, it stuck like an ooze into Eiri’s gloved hands. “Feels like nothing—what is this?” She recoiled, hanging her hand down, letting the white fire ooze drip off her fingers. The fire did not consume her yellow gloves, or spread out at all. Instead, its flames began to die off as it dripped towards the ground, dissipating into nothingness. Soon after the white fire that was on her hand burned itself out, leaving no traces of it, like a puddle disappearing in a hot sun.
038b10af6d03.t: Dia menggigit pipinya, dan mendekati api putih itu. Menyentuh tepinya, ia melekat seperti lendir pada tangan Eiri yang bersarung. “Rasa macam tak ada apa-apa—apa benda ni?” Dia tersentak ke belakang, menjuntaikan tangannya ke bawah, membiarkan lendir api putih itu menitis dari jarinya. Api itu tidak memakan sarung tangan kuningnya, atau merebak langsung. Sebaliknya, nyalaannya mula padam ketika ia menitis ke tanah, lenyap menjadi tiada. Tidak lama kemudian api putih di tangannya habis terbakar, tidak meninggalkan sebarang kesan, seperti lopak air yang hilang di bawah terik matahari.

06e817f7a2bf.en: Eiri, with a smile and curved eyebrows, tried to find words amidst an insecure hum. “Hmmm—not sure you’re going to believe—”
06e817f7a2bf.t: Eiri, dengan senyuman dan kening melengkung, cuba mencari kata-kata di tengah-tengah dengungan yang tidak yakin. “Hmmm—tak pasti kau akan percaya—”

08924abab677.en: A grunt came out of Kibe as his limp body did not take kindly to being moved around. He stood up, but soon leaned against the drawers, like a shit-faced drunk person trying to pee, but ended up resting on the toilet instead.
08924abab677.t: Kibe merengus kerana tubuhnya yang lemah tidak suka diusung ke sana ke mari. Dia berdiri, tetapi tidak lama kemudian bersandar pada laci, seperti orang mabuk teruk yang cuba kencing tetapi akhirnya terduduk di atas tandas.

099662ec4198.en: Kibe tried to resist it at first with a closed mouth, but seeing as Eiri was not pulling the jar away, even after he whimpered like a dog and faintly shook his head, he accepted his fate by filling his lungs. Eating it up, he looked to be regurgitating, but did not end up throwing up. Instead, his skin goose bumped as he tried to half-eat, half-drink the overly sugary, nearly diabetic-inducing black substance as fast as possible, making a tear come out of his eyes.
099662ec4198.t: Kibe cuba menolak pada mulanya dengan mulut tertutup, tetapi melihat Eiri tidak menarik balang itu, walaupun selepas dia merengek seperti anjing dan menggeleng kepala dengan lemah, dia menerima nasibnya dengan menarik nafas panjang. Sambil memakannya, dia kelihatan seperti mahu termuntah, tetapi tidak sampai muntah. Sebaliknya, kulitnya meremang ketika dia cuba separuh makan, separuh minum bahan hitam yang terlampau manis, hampir boleh menyebabkan kencing manis itu secepat mungkin, sehingga air mata keluar dari matanya.

0e888f5e33c4.en: Itagiba, appearing impervious as the fanchaki kicked and scratched him, kept fighting to retain his grip on the bird’s head. “NO!—ugh—YOU’RE GONNA LISTEN TO ME THIS TIME!—ARGH!”
0e888f5e33c4.t: Itagiba, kelihatan tidak terkesan ketika fanchaki itu menendang dan mencakarnya, terus bergelut untuk mengekalkan cengkamannya pada kepala burung itu. “TAK!—ugh—KALI NI KAU KENA DENGAR CAKAP AKU!—ARGH!”

0fc68eef51b5.en: Kibe remained sitting, with his head down, his voice forcing his way out of his mouth. “Gabiro did it. I have no idea what happened.”
0fc68eef51b5.t: Kibe kekal duduk, kepala menunduk, suaranya memaksa diri keluar dari mulut. “Gabiro yang buat. Aku tak tahu apa yang jadi.”

1060c21b0932.en: Kibe closed his eyes and tried to scrape his tongue with his front teeth. Spitting the remains on the floor, he attempted to clean his dirty mouth on his blood-soaked rags. “Argh. Way too sweet. I hate it!”
1060c21b0932.t: Kibe memejamkan mata dan cuba mengikis lidahnya dengan gigi depan. Meludahkan sisa-sisanya ke lantai, dia cuba membersihkan mulutnya yang kotor pada kain buruknya yang basah dengan darah. “Argh. Manis gila. Aku benci!”

1267ae458ba7.en: A disappointed fatherly breath came out of Itagiba, his hand grasping Kibe’s slumped shoulder. “I thought so—that’s okay. Go take a shower, and jerk it or something. Maybe it will help. Let me handle the fatso, while you figure out how to bring Gabiro back.”
1267ae458ba7.t: Satu hembusan nafas kecewa seorang bapa keluar daripada Itagiba, tangannya menggenggam bahu Kibe yang terlorot. “Dah agak dah—tak apa. Pergi mandi, dan melancap ke apa. Mungkin membantu. Biar aku uruskan si gemuk tu, sementara kau cari jalan nak bawa Gabiro balik.”

12ee98a500a8.en: “All right! I’m gonna go get the girls. See ya in a bit.” Itagiba walked towards the castle as he waved at one of the onlookers, someone other than the nearly balding corpulent male, an older woman, with bright green hair, adjusted herself to a pose to reveal her body as much as possible towards Itagiba, then winking at him, as he dared to look towards her again—one would expect she would start doing an annoying cat-in-heat call next, but perhaps she was too far away to be heard. Not that it would make a difference anyway as Itagiba continued to ignore her.
12ee98a500a8.t: “Baiklah! Aku nak pergi ambil budak-budak perempuan. Jumpa nanti.” Itagiba berjalan ke arah istana sambil melambai kepada salah seorang penonton, seseorang selain lelaki gempal yang hampir botak itu, seorang wanita tua berambut hijau terang, membetulkan posturnya untuk mendedahkan tubuhnya seboleh mungkin ke arah Itagiba, kemudian mengenyitkan mata kepadanya, ketika dia berani memandang ke arahnya lagi—orang mungkin menyangka dia akan mula mengeluarkan bunyi menjengkelkan seperti kucing miang selepas itu, tetapi mungkin dia terlalu jauh untuk didengar. Bukannya ada beza pun kerana Itagiba terus tidak mengendahkannya.

12fb5f2d032c.en: Kibe, still holding the spell, remained mostly motionless, except for his eyes tracking Eiri moving about. “Why bother? I filled him with Body Restore.”
12fb5f2d032c.t: Kibe, masih memegang jampi itu, kekal hampir tidak bergerak, kecuali matanya yang mengekori Eiri ke sana ke mari. “Buat apa susah-susah? Aku dah isi dia dengan Body Restore.”

133b3b2ea195.en: Letting out a gurgled high-pitched shriek, amidst a panicked recovery, the bird chomped down on Kibe’s finger, only to then kick him in the chest, sending him flying backwards, towards Itagiba.
133b3b2ea195.t: Mengeluarkan jeritan nyaring yang berdeguk, di tengah-tengah pemulihan yang panik, burung itu menggigit jari Kibe, lalu menendang dadanya, menghantarnya terpelanting ke belakang, ke arah Itagiba.

13b7b8369dba.en: Eiri, realizing the eyeballs beginning to stare in her direction, gave a quick smile, and a wave of her hand. Gabiro is gonna have to explain that tomorrow.
13b7b8369dba.t: Eiri, menyedari banyak mata mula merenung ke arahnya, memberikan senyuman pantas dan lambaian tangan. Gabiro kena terangkan pasal tu esok.

16d03a009880.en: Itagiba, not even acknowledging Kibe, continued to size up how succulent the fanchaki looked. “I’m kinda thinking half soup, half—”
16d03a009880.t: Itagiba, langsung tidak mengendahkan Kibe, terus menilai betapa enaknya rupa fanchaki itu. “Aku tengah fikir separuh buat sup, separuh—”

170854c45d99.en: “Gabiro told me to always crank it up.” Kibe put the empty nari chain aside, and grabbed a third one.
170854c45d99.t: “Gabiro suruh aku sentiasa naikkan habis.” Kibe meletakkan rantai nari yang kosong ke tepi, dan mengambil yang ketiga.

17429c817db8.en: “Is he still not coming back?” Eiri, eyed the mostly empty black honey jar by Kibe.
17429c817db8.t: “Dia masih tak hidup balik?” Eiri mengerling balang madu hitam yang hampir kosong di sisi Kibe.

177c98bc437f.en: Eiri was spared. Instead, she watched the bird appear like it had just drunk a gallon of coffee, running off in a straight path away from the group, singing a rather rhythmic cacophony of clucks, with feathers being left behind in the wind.
177c98bc437f.t: Eiri terselamat. Sebaliknya, dia melihat burung itu kelihatan seperti baru minum segelen kopi, berlari dalam garis lurus menjauhi kumpulan itu, menyanyikan hiruk-pikuk kokokan yang agak berirama, dengan bulu-bulu tertinggal ditiup angin.

1a1207dca8bd.en: “Kibe?—you dead?” An inquisitive, yet hopeful tone slipped out of Eiri, while breathing through her mouth.
1a1207dca8bd.t: “Kibe?—kau dah mati?” Nada ingin tahu, namun penuh harapan, terlepas daripada Eiri sambil dia bernafas melalui mulut.

1d0c3903ee91.en: A refreshing breeze swept through, making the colorful flowers dance, and Kibe clinked his teeth, shivering as he attempted to check Gabiro’s pulse in his thin frail neck.
1d0c3903ee91.t: Angin yang menyegarkan bertiup, membuatkan bunga-bunga berwarna-warni menari, dan gigi Kibe berlaga, menggigil ketika dia cuba memeriksa nadi Gabiro pada lehernya yang kurus dan rapuh.

1d3cdc3d1b3b.en: “JUST GO! I need to find something for this fatso to wear, or Sora will have a panic attack!” Eiri kept looking through the backstock of random stuff ranging from clothing to metallic scientific instruments, some with blue nari stones, others with gels, and even some with dissected animal parts.
1d3cdc3d1b3b.t: “PERGI AJELAH! Aku kena cari sesuatu untuk si gemuk ni pakai, kalau tak Sora kena serangan panik!” Eiri terus menyelongkar stok simpanan barang-barang rawak, daripada pakaian hingga peralatan saintifik logam, sesetengahnya dengan batu nari biru, sesetengahnya dengan gel, malah ada yang berisi bahagian haiwan yang dibedah.

2146e98e3892.en: “Kibe! That’s too much!” blurted out Eiri, but it was to no avail as she saw Kibe’s hand making another trapping hand motion on the nari chain, sucking out all the blue hue from it, transforming it into a fourth storm ball.
2146e98e3892.t: “Kibe! Itu terlalu banyak!” Eiri terlepas cakap, tetapi sia-sia sahaja apabila dia melihat tangan Kibe membuat satu lagi gerakan memerangkap pada rantai nari, menyedut keluar semua warna biru daripadanya, mengubahnya menjadi bola ribut keempat.

253058e02ae1.en: Eiri opened another drawer, and pulled a glass jar filled with a black thick substance. “This is for your own good—” She leaned Kibe upright against the wall, popped the glass jar open, and placed it on his mouth, making sure he drank, or rather, ate this thick black substance looking like a molasses mixed with honey known as black honey.
253058e02ae1.t: Eiri membuka laci lain dan mengeluarkan balang kaca berisi bahan hitam yang pekat. “Ini untuk kebaikan kau sendiri—” Dia menyandarkan Kibe tegak pada dinding, membuka balang kaca itu dan meletakkannya di mulut Kibe, memastikan dia meminum, atau lebih tepat, memakan bahan hitam pekat yang kelihatan seperti molases bercampur madu yang dikenali sebagai madu hitam.

28046b3ea5c5.en: Eiri, looking through the slits of her gloved hands, did not feel any heat from the large fire. “Kibe! Is—is—this soul fire?”
28046b3ea5c5.t: Eiri, mengintai melalui celah jari tangannya yang bersarung, tidak merasakan sebarang haba daripada api besar itu. “Kibe! Ini—ini—api jiwa ke?”

2a47447ffcba.en: “I’m truly sorry, king-maid! I heard the wrong size! I’m sorry!” Sora, the maid, blushed red as her trembling lips appeared as if she was about to be executed for treason.
2a47447ffcba.t: “Saya betul-betul minta maaf, king-maid! Saya tersalah dengar saiz! Maaf!” Sora, si pembantu rumah, merah padam sementara bibirnya yang menggeletar kelihatan seolah-olah dia akan dihukum bunuh kerana derhaka.

2b7ac8e02537.en: Eiri picked up another shard, and held its blade-thin edge towards Kibe, “Would you want to wake up dying?” She dropped it on the pile, making a loud clack as the shard split into two.
2b7ac8e02537.t: Eiri memungut satu lagi serpihan, dan menghalakan bucunya yang setipis bilah ke arah Kibe, “Kau nak bangun dalam keadaan nazak?” Dia menjatuhkannya ke atas timbunan, berbunyi kuat ketika serpihan itu terbelah dua.

2beef48d0a69.en: The white flames grew brighter, and blinding, like staring at the sun in the morning, as it further swallowed Gabiro, turning his body into a pile of ooze, growing much taller—getting close to Eiri’s hips in terms of height. The entire white fire unnaturally weaved back and forth in a rhythmic, constant motion, completely ignoring the wind playing with the nearby grass.
2beef48d0a69.t: Api putih itu menjadi semakin terang dan menyilaukan, seperti merenung matahari pagi, ketika ia terus menelan Gabiro, mengubah tubuhnya menjadi timbunan lendir, semakin tinggi—hampir separas pinggul Eiri. Seluruh api putih itu meliuk-liuk ke depan dan ke belakang secara luar biasa dalam gerakan berirama yang tetap, langsung tidak mengendahkan angin yang bermain dengan rumput berdekatan.

2cf488ad8fa3.en: Eiri, quieter than before, replied “Yeah—Sora is in the Southwest tower right now. I’m gonna go get the maids ready for cleanup, and put in a work order for the window too.”
2cf488ad8fa3.t: Eiri, lebih perlahan daripada tadi, menjawab “Ya—Sora ada kat menara Barat Daya sekarang. Aku nak pergi siapkan para pembantu rumah untuk bersihkan, dan buat pesanan kerja untuk tingkap tu juga.”

2f2ceeafca02.en: Kibe, with a weak nod, made his way back into the same tower he got out from, while Eiri approached Itagiba’s side. “Need anything from me?”
2f2ceeafca02.t: Kibe, dengan anggukan lemah, kembali ke menara yang sama dia keluar tadi, sementara Eiri mendekati sisi Itagiba. “Perlukan apa-apa daripada aku?”

302d716e5f55.en: Chapter I - Unexpected Aftermath · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
302d716e5f55.t: Bab I - Akibat Tidak Dijangka · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

344e946c7e08.en: Eiri, noticing the onlooker letting her breath go, saw her breasts sink, revealing a slumped belly. Next, she turned her back to her, and left the balcony. Eiri let out a laugh from her nose, moving her head slowly from side to side as she switched her focus to the pool of mostly dried blood, pile of glass shards, then at the large fanchaki now peeking at a distant flower garden. Eiri’s eyes grew serious, biting her cheeks. “If that’s not a fake body, then who are you?” She spoke under her breath.
344e946c7e08.t: Eiri, perasan penonton itu melepaskan nafasnya, melihat buah dadanya melorot, mendedahkan perut yang buncit. Kemudian, wanita itu membelakanginya dan meninggalkan balkoni. Eiri ketawa melalui hidung, menggeleng kepala perlahan-lahan sambil mengalihkan tumpuan kepada lopak darah yang kebanyakannya sudah kering, timbunan serpihan kaca, kemudian kepada fanchaki besar yang kini mematuk-matuk ke arah taman bunga yang jauh. Mata Eiri menjadi serius, menggigit pipinya. “Kalau itu bukan fake body, habis tu kau siapa?” Dia bercakap perlahan-lahan.

3463b14a12b2.en: “Yes, king-maid! Sorry!” Sora, the freestyle rap machine, or just the extremely energetic maid, now red as tomato, took off running towards the tower on the far right, also called Southeast Tower.
3463b14a12b2.t: “Baik, king-maid! Maaf!” Sora, mesin rap bebas, atau sekadar pembantu rumah yang terlampau bertenaga, kini merah seperti tomato, berlari pergi menuju menara di hujung kanan, juga dipanggil Menara Tenggara.

3557f7531205.en: Blocking the sun with her hands, she looked back at the broken window on the fourth floor, letting out a long-winded hum. Is that strange interface the soul itself?
3557f7531205.t: Menghalang matahari dengan tangannya, dia memandang semula tingkap pecah di tingkat empat, mengeluarkan dengungan panjang. Antara muka yang pelik tu jiwa itu sendiri ke?

390f41673546.en: Shoving the two rings, another jar of black honey, plus a few unused nari chains into Kibe’s pockets, Eiri did not take kindly to the spit. Pausing her rush, she stared at Kibe with souring lips. “I’m gonna let it fly this time. Now go ahead! Quickly!”
390f41673546.t: Sambil menyumbatkan dua cincin itu, sebalang lagi madu hitam, dan beberapa rantai nari yang belum digunakan ke dalam poket Kibe, Eiri tidak suka dengan ludah itu. Menghentikan kekalutannya, dia merenung Kibe dengan bibir mencebik. “Kali ni aku lepaskan. Sekarang pergi! Cepat!”

3b421228c6e1.en: No response. The stranger was limp, looking like he was out cold after chugging a whole bottle of whisky.
3b421228c6e1.t: Tiada jawapan. Orang asing itu terkulai, kelihatan seperti pengsan selepas meneguk sebotol penuh wiski.

3bc49aa9c0aa.en: She wore the Body Restore sigil ring on her middle and left fingers, grabbed a blue nari stone chain in the ground, then kneeled in front of Kibe, assessing how bad he looked. She touched his cheek, but like a tree falling in the forest, Kibe’s head made cracking sounds as it fell to the side, aberrantly resting on the shoulder. So it really was an explosion!
3bc49aa9c0aa.t: Dia memakai cincin sigil Body Restore pada jari tengah dan jari kirinya, mengambil rantai batu nari biru di lantai, lalu melutut di hadapan Kibe, menilai betapa teruk keadaannya. Dia menyentuh pipinya, tetapi seperti pokok tumbang di hutan, kepala Kibe mengeluarkan bunyi berderak ketika ia jatuh ke sisi, terlentok dengan janggal di atas bahu. Jadi memang letupan rupanya!

3ebc0be419d3.en: What in the Sanbi happened here? Eiri Sanbi Royal, a girl in her twenties dressed in fancy maid clothing, with sapphires shining in her collar, stood in the doorframe, her mouth open, and bulged eyes tried to take in the present situation of the room. The door she was supposed to open lay at her feet, collecting dust from the settling cloud, amidst a pungent smell of decay and bagarisa musk that smelled like a wet dog spreading from within the room. An unknown person, completely naked, lay there as if he was sunbathing. Accompanying him in that solace moment was a dead scientist apprentice by the name of Kibe.
3ebc0be419d3.t: Demi jiwa tua Sanbi, apa yang berlaku di sini? Eiri Sanbi Royal, seorang gadis berusia dua puluhan berpakaian pembantu rumah yang mewah, dengan batu sapphire berkilau di kolarnya, berdiri di ambang pintu dengan mulut ternganga, dan matanya yang terbeliak cuba memahami keadaan bilik itu. Pintu yang sepatutnya dia buka terbaring di kakinya, dihinggapi debu daripada awan yang mula mendap, di tengah-tengah bau busuk reput dan bau kasturi bagarisa seperti anjing basah yang merebak dari dalam bilik. Seorang yang tidak dikenali, berbogel sepenuhnya, terbaring di situ seolah-olah sedang berjemur. Menemaninya dalam saat sepi itu ialah seorang pelatih saintis yang sudah mati bernama Kibe.

45b52f232425.en: Eiri jiggled her finger above Itagiba, towards the broken window on the fourth floor.
45b52f232425.t: Eiri menggoyang-goyangkan jarinya di atas Itagiba, ke arah tingkap pecah di tingkat empat.

4a54f56f0942.en: Eiri, only removing the glove from her right hand, performed the same hand ritualistic trickery as Gabiro to get a spell started, but instead of using a blade to carve her skin with logograms, she used the sigil ring, on her left hand, to touch its faceplate on her right palm. She followed it by feeding the entire nari chain until three red, instead of white, balls of double helices appeared, and zoomed on the white rings around her arm. Unclenching her fingers, she released the spell into Kibe’s body.
4a54f56f0942.t: Eiri, hanya menanggalkan sarung tangan dari tangan kanannya, melakukan helah ritual tangan yang sama seperti Gabiro untuk memulakan jampi, tetapi bukannya menggunakan bilah untuk mengukir logogram pada kulitnya, dia menggunakan cincin sigil di tangan kirinya, menyentuhkan plat mukanya pada tapak tangan kanannya. Dia diikuti dengan menyuapkan seluruh rantai nari sehingga tiga bola heliks berganda berwarna merah, dan bukannya putih, muncul dan meluncur pada gelang-gelang putih di sekeliling lengannya. Membuka genggaman jarinya, dia melepaskan jampi itu ke dalam tubuh Kibe.

4a6c8e2e765a.en: A weak shrug came out of Kibe, as he powered up the Body Restore spell, making two red balls of double helix strands appear in the white fire rings.
4a6c8e2e765a.t: Kibe mengangkat bahu dengan lemah, sambil menghidupkan jampi Body Restore, membuatkan dua bola merah helaian heliks berganda muncul di dalam gelang api putih.

4d8c5ad7759d.en: “He didn’t come back!” With her hands pointed at the absolutely-dead-looking corpse, Eiri’s tone changed to inquisitive. “Did you even check his badge?—what?—what in the old Sanbi is that?”
4d8c5ad7759d.t: “Dia tak hidup balik!” Dengan tangannya menunjuk ke arah mayat yang kelihatan benar-benar mati itu, nada Eiri bertukar ingin tahu. “Kau ada periksa lencana dia tak?—apa?—demi jiwa tua Sanbi, apa benda tu?”

4df16027e66e.en: Itagiba scratched the blue hair strands of his mostly black hair. “So the same they were gonna do to the slum guy?”
4df16027e66e.t: Itagiba menggaru helaian rambut biru di celah rambutnya yang kebanyakannya hitam. “Jadi sama macam yang mereka nak buat pada mamat setinggan tu?”

4e0dae442d15.en: Eiri’s frown turned into an indifferent smile, looking at the buildings poking through the top of the wall that surrounded them, seeing some people curiously looking on, as if they were about to write a hit piece on a gossip magazine. Amongst them, an older, nearly bald man ate an early lunch by holding a plate with one hand and stuffing his face with the other. Focused on the gossip unfolding in real time, he could not even stop to look at his fork as he shoved food down his piehole.
4e0dae442d15.t: Kerutan Eiri bertukar menjadi senyuman acuh tak acuh, memandang bangunan-bangunan yang menjengul di atas tembok yang mengelilingi mereka, ternampak beberapa orang memerhati dengan penuh ingin tahu, seolah-olah mereka hendak menulis artikel sensasi untuk majalah gosip. Di antara mereka, seorang lelaki tua yang hampir botak sedang makan tengah hari awal dengan memegang pinggan di sebelah tangan dan menyumbat mukanya dengan tangan yang lagi satu. Terlalu khusyuk dengan gosip yang berlaku secara langsung, dia tidak sempat pun memandang garpunya ketika menyumbat makanan ke dalam mulutnya.

4e331d5a0cc9.en: “Fan—chaki?” exclaimed Eiri as a bead of sweat went down her cheek. A single chuckle came out, as her neck bent to the side. Arrhythmically blinking, a few more chuckles suddenly blurted out, then a laughter breakdown exploded from her. Her own brain denied the very thing in front of her eyes, all while a familiar face approached in the background.
4e331d5a0cc9.t: “Fan—chaki?” Eiri berseru ketika setitis peluh mengalir di pipinya. Satu ketawa kecil keluar, sambil lehernya terteleng ke sisi. Berkelip mata tidak menentu, beberapa ketawa lagi tiba-tiba terhambur, kemudian ketawanya meledak tidak terkawal. Otaknya sendiri menafikan apa yang ada di depan matanya, sementara satu wajah yang dikenali menghampiri di latar belakang.

4fd8d9fb8930.en: With a weak nod, Kibe stood up, grabbing the last nari chain stick with one hand, and a sigil ring for Body Restore with the other, begrudgingly making his way towards the fainted bird, with its pecker dented into the ground.
4fd8d9fb8930.t: Dengan anggukan lemah, Kibe berdiri, memegang batang rantai nari terakhir di sebelah tangan, dan cincin sigil Body Restore di tangan yang lagi satu, dengan berat hati menuju ke arah burung yang pengsan itu, dengan paruhnya terbenam ke dalam tanah.

4fdf1fb27298.en: “Riiiiight—then where’s the slum guy?” Itagiba’s tone sounded more sarcastic, than unconvinced.
4fdf1fb27298.t: “Yelah tuuu—habis tu mana mamat setinggan tu?” Nada Itagiba kedengaran lebih menyindir daripada tidak percaya.

51981805b0db.en: Kibe shook his head as the first ball of dark clouds, with flashing lighting, began zipping inside the smaller white fire ring around Kibe’s left forearm. One ball became two as Kibe continued feeding chains of nari stones, then finally three when the rest of the blue hue in the stick was sucked towards Kibe’s palm. Throwing the now diamond-like, empty stick aside, Kibe pulled another stick from the large pocket in his robe.
51981805b0db.t: Kibe menggeleng ketika bola pertama awan gelap, dengan kilat berkelip, mula meluncur di dalam gelang api putih yang lebih kecil di sekeliling lengan bawah kiri Kibe. Satu bola menjadi dua ketika Kibe terus menyuapkan rantai batu nari, kemudian akhirnya tiga apabila baki warna biru dalam batang itu disedut ke arah tapak tangan Kibe. Mencampakkan batang yang kini kosong seperti berlian itu ke tepi, Kibe menarik satu lagi batang dari poket besar jubahnya.

556f58745c18.en: Eiri’s worrying lips stretched out thin, noticing the semblance in the white fire on the rings around Kibe’s hand versus the white fire ooze from earlier. “Soul rings? Were they messing directly with the soul?”
556f58745c18.t: Bibir Eiri yang risau menipis, perasan persamaan antara api putih pada gelang di sekeliling tangan Kibe dengan lendir api putih tadi. “Gelang jiwa? Mereka main-main terus dengan jiwa ke?”

5b08a94fd017.en: Eiri, biting her lips, analyzed the protuberance of this stranger’s gut and the overall balloon shape of his body. She had imagined someone completely different—a hero-like, all-powerful, panty-dropping male. “No way! It can’t be!” She let out a chuckle, sticking two fingers on his short neck, putting pressure until she felt a slow, constant pulse beating against the glove protecting her fingers. Meanwhile, her eyes glanced towards his floppy privates hanging to the right. Sizing it up with her eyes, then playing with its floppiness with her free gloved hand, her eyebrows curved. Heh—not bad for a Toleridemian!” Eiri looked around the room again. “Eh—he doesn’t look right. Gabiro?”
5b08a94fd017.t: Eiri, menggigit bibir, meneliti perut buncit orang asing ini dan bentuk tubuhnya yang keseluruhannya seperti belon. Dia membayangkan seseorang yang sama sekali berbeza—seorang lelaki seperti wira, serba berkuasa, yang membuat wanita tergila-gila. “Takkanlah! Mustahil!” Dia tergelak kecil, meletakkan dua jari pada leher pendek lelaki itu, menekan sehingga dia merasakan denyutan perlahan dan tetap berdetak pada sarung tangan yang melindungi jarinya. Sementara itu, matanya mengerling ke arah kemaluannya yang lembik terjuntai ke kanan. Mengukurnya dengan mata, kemudian bermain-main dengan kelembikannya menggunakan tangannya yang bersarung lagi satu, keningnya melengkung. Heh—boleh tahan untuk orang Tolerideme!” Eiri memandang sekeliling bilik sekali lagi. “Eh—dia nampak macam tak kena. Gabiro?”

5c0bfb19363b.en: Eiri placed her gloved hands in the way. “Wait! I got something else for you. Go get the guest’s bath ready! And forget about the size, he’s more Toleridemian than Sanbi.”
5c0bfb19363b.t: Eiri menghalang dengan tangannya yang bersarung. “Tunggu! Aku ada kerja lain untuk kau. Pergi sediakan bilik mandi tetamu! Dan lupakan pasal saiz, dia lebih Toleridemian daripada Sanbi.”

5c453f9ecabe.en: “Stop! Maiara clearly said what she wanted, and this old fart makes me a Toleridemian?” Itagiba stepped closer to the unconscious fanchaki, bent forward and pulled on its feathery black and white crest, lifting its contrastingly small head off the ground. “WHAT THE FUCK IS WRONG WITH YOU! THE DUEL IS TOMORROW!” He screamed right where one’s ear would be.
5c453f9ecabe.t: “Berhenti! Maiara dah jelas cakap apa yang dia nak, dan orang tua kerepot ni bagi aku orang Tolerideme?” Itagiba melangkah mendekati fanchaki yang tidak sedarkan diri itu, membongkok dan menarik jambulnya yang berbulu hitam putih, mengangkat kepalanya yang kecil secara kontras dari tanah. “APA BENDA CELAKA YANG TAK KENA DENGAN KAU NI! PERTARUNGAN TU ESOK!” Dia menjerit betul-betul di tempat yang sepatutnya ada telinga.

6439c809b7b1.en: The shards looked bloodthirsty with their sharp edges, even more so after being foiled from cutting up an old man’s leathery skin, but Eiri’s precise carefulness, alongside the protection from her yellow gloves, kept on piling up the glass shards without donating a single droplet of her blood.
6439c809b7b1.t: Serpihan-serpihan itu kelihatan dahagakan darah dengan bucu tajamnya, lebih-lebih lagi selepas gagal menghiris kulit seorang lelaki tua yang seperti kulit lembu, tetapi kecermatan Eiri yang teliti, bersama perlindungan sarung tangan kuningnya, terus menimbun serpihan kaca tanpa menderma setitik pun darahnya.

66291f15ef25.en: Itagiba didn’t seem to care as he watched Kibe struggle to pull the bird’s pecker off the ground, as if it was as demanding as pulling out Excalibur. He instead came closer to Eiri. “You sure that’s Gabiro?”
66291f15ef25.t: Itagiba nampaknya tidak peduli ketika melihat Kibe bersusah payah menarik paruh burung itu keluar dari tanah, seolah-olah ia sesukar mencabut Excalibur. Sebaliknya dia mendekati Eiri. “Kau pasti tu Gabiro?”

682413b8fbec.en: Shaking her head, Eiri replied, “No, Itagiba. I was on my way up the tower when I heard a loud crash, but when I came into the room I saw everything torn up, and the Toleridemian-looking guy passed out on the table—”
682413b8fbec.t: Menggeleng kepala, Eiri menjawab, “Bukan, Itagiba. Aku tengah naik menara bila dengar bunyi dentuman kuat, tapi bila aku masuk bilik aku nampak semuanya berselerak, dan lelaki yang macam orang Tolerideme tu pengsan atas meja—”

684a14fe1443.en: Kibe, looking quite comfortable, even though he was leaning against a solid stone wall, let out a faint whimper. “Can you do it for me? I’m on PTO.”
684a14fe1443.t: Kibe, kelihatan agak selesa walaupun bersandar pada dinding batu yang keras, mengeluarkan rengekan lemah. “Boleh kau buatkan untuk aku? Aku tengah cuti.”

6aaa86816124.en: Why would there be an explosion? Eiri pictured the room in her mind again, remembering the ground being littered with used nari stones. I thought they were creating a new fake body—I didn’t see any nari gel though. Eiri, continually picking glass, asked Kibe, “How can you create a legit fake body on the Darfaries interface?”
6aaa86816124.t: Kenapa pula ada letupan? Eiri membayangkan semula bilik itu dalam fikirannya, teringat lantainya bersepah dengan batu nari terpakai. Aku ingat mereka tengah cipta fake body baru—tapi aku tak nampak pun nari gel. Eiri, sambil terus memungut kaca, bertanya kepada Kibe, “Macam mana nak cipta fake body yang betul-betul jadi guna antara muka Darfaries?”

6acbadc14b24.en: Am I going to be the one who has to explain all of this? Eiri, focused back towards Gabiro’s relaxed body, frowned again. “So you don’t remember at all?”
6acbadc14b24.t: Akukah yang kena terangkan semua ni? Eiri, kembali menumpukan perhatian pada tubuh Gabiro yang terkulai, berkerut lagi. “Jadi kau langsung tak ingat?”

6e8f8125a320.en: She retreated her head slowly, but once inside, an anxious grin formed in her face, as her hands rushed to open the second drawer, top-to-bottom, of a nearby white cabinet. Where is it?
6e8f8125a320.t: Dia menarik kepalanya perlahan-lahan, tetapi sebaik sahaja di dalam, senyuman cemas terukir di wajahnya, sambil tangannya bergegas membuka laci kedua, dari atas ke bawah, sebuah kabinet putih berdekatan. Mana dia?

6ede13f295f8.en: Eiri responded with a short sigh, grabbing his hand, and pulling him up forcibly. “C’mon! We need to get him up!”
6ede13f295f8.t: Eiri membalas dengan keluhan pendek, menggenggam tangannya dan menariknya bangun secara paksa. “Cepatlah! Kita kena angkat dia!”

6f2ac4991150.en: What in the Sanbi happened here? Eiri Sanbi Royal, a girl in her twenties dressed in fancy maid clothing, with sapphires shining in her collar, stood in the…
6f2ac4991150.t: Demi jiwa tua Sanbi, apa yang berlaku di sini? Eiri Sanbi Royal, seorang gadis berusia dua puluhan berpakaian pembantu rumah yang mewah, dengan batu sapphire berkilau di kolarnya, berdiri di…

70c493e0e43c.en: Eiri, falling victim to the advertisement aria, remembered two of her maids were taking care of the kitchen today. Did I tell them to buy more legunia?
70c493e0e43c.t: Eiri, menjadi mangsa aria iklan itu, teringat dua orang pembantu rumahnya menjaga dapur hari ini. Aku dah suruh mereka beli legunia lagi ke?

7177781248bd.en: Kibe sat there, shifting his weight on his knees, as he looked away from the maids, with one hand still holding the spell, while the other idled, sometimes scratching the dried blood away from his chin.
7177781248bd.t: Kibe duduk di situ, mengalihkan berat badan pada lututnya, sambil mengalihkan pandangan dari para pembantu rumah, dengan sebelah tangan masih memegang jampi, sementara sebelah lagi melahu, sesekali menggaruk darah kering dari dagunya.

72e850adeeea.en: Following Eiri’s fingers up, Itagiba used his hand to block out the sunny sky. A whistle came out of him, noticing the broken window, and finally connecting the dots as to what they were doing out there. “He can fight already? Sweet! That’s awesome!” His voice went up an octave at the end.
72e850adeeea.t: Mengikut jari Eiri ke atas, Itagiba menggunakan tangannya untuk menghalang langit yang cerah. Satu siulan keluar daripadanya, ternampak tingkap yang pecah, dan akhirnya dapat menghubungkan titik-titik tentang apa yang mereka buat di luar sana. “Dia dah boleh bertarung? Mantap! Hebatnya!” Suaranya naik satu oktaf di hujung.

780b53431afa.en: “I—I can’t. I don’t know what Gabiro did. It’s his fault!” Kibe looked down, his shoulders slumped forwards. “There’s nothing I can do! I don’t even want this—”
780b53431afa.t: “S—saya tak boleh. Saya tak tahu apa yang Gabiro buat. Salah dia!” Kibe menunduk, bahunya terlorot ke depan. “Tak ada apa yang saya boleh buat! Saya pun tak nak benda ni—”

7f63f9dc21cf.en: Just what were you two doing? Carefully making her way to the suspicious broken window, Eiri peeked her way through, and saw a bustling seaside kingdom separated by a castle wall, protecting a lusty green courtyard full of flowers beautifying the boxy-looking castle in the middle of it.
7f63f9dc21cf.t: Apa sebenarnya yang korang berdua buat ni? Berhati-hati menuju ke tingkap pecah yang mencurigakan itu, Eiri mengintai keluar, dan ternampak sebuah kerajaan tepi laut yang sibuk dipisahkan oleh tembok istana, melindungi halaman hijau subur yang penuh bunga yang mencantikkan istana berbentuk kotak di tengah-tengahnya.

8217812f33ba.en: A tiny white flame emerged from the nucleus of the wound, and slowly began spreading itself.
8217812f33ba.t: Satu nyalaan api putih kecil muncul dari pusat luka itu, dan perlahan-lahan mula merebak.

82cfbf297c02.en: Kibe did as told, making the fanchaki’s small tongue flop to the side within its large opened dirtied beak. Eiri first tapped the dirt off it with her gloved hands, then tapped the glass on the upper beak, making the leftover black honey sloop against its small tongue, and run down the fanchaki’s throat.
82cfbf297c02.t: Kibe menurut, membuatkan lidah kecil fanchaki itu terjelir ke tepi di dalam paruhnya yang besar, terbuka dan kotor. Eiri mula-mula menepuk tanah dari paruh itu dengan tangannya yang bersarung, kemudian mengetuk balang itu pada paruh atas, membuatkan sisa madu hitam meleleh ke atas lidahnya yang kecil, dan mengalir ke kerongkong fanchaki itu.

83a6f096954f.en: Cutting off Eiri, Kibe placed his hand on the large, perhaps dead, fanchaki in front of him, and spoke faster than usual, fumbling through his enunciation. “S—she told me to do it! I was at Waterfall! I—I don’t remember coming back here!”
83a6f096954f.t: Memotong cakap Eiri, Kibe meletakkan tangannya pada fanchaki besar yang mungkin sudah mati di hadapannya, dan bercakap lebih laju daripada biasa, tergagap-gagap menyebut perkataan. “D—dia yang suruh aku buat! Aku kat Waterfall! A—aku tak ingat pun balik ke sini!”

88d0f5c300ea.en: While the convulsions steadily subsided, the same cowboy cigarette advertisement voice from before drew closer—“For only thirteen pearls! Grab your juicy fanchaki breasts at Tony’s Meatery! They are extra thick and juicy!” The voice, now passing by the other side of the wall, was accompanied by the sound of a fat horse trotting, adding a constant beat, now turning the advertisement into a sort of an aria, loud enough to captivate anyone nearby, even if for a split second.
88d0f5c300ea.t: Sementara kekejangan itu beransur reda, suara koboi iklan rokok yang sama tadi semakin hampir—“Hanya tiga belas Pearl! Dapatkan dada fanchaki yang berair di Tony’s Meatery! Ekstra tebal dan berair!” Suara itu, kini melintasi sebelah sana tembok, diiringi bunyi seekor kuda gemuk berlari anak, menambah rentak yang tetap, kini menjadikan iklan itu semacam aria, cukup kuat untuk memikat sesiapa sahaja berdekatan, walaupun hanya sesaat.

8c8d4f2e8697.en: “I’m fine either way as long as Maiara got what she wanted.” Itagiba let slip an honest-sounding thought through his mouth, while his pinky went deep digging in his ear.
8c8d4f2e8697.t: “Aku tak kisah yang mana pun asalkan Maiara dapat apa yang dia nak.” Itagiba terlepas satu fikiran yang kedengaran jujur melalui mulutnya, sementara jari kelingkingnya mengorek jauh ke dalam telinga.

92616766456d.en: Itagiba and Eiri exchanged chuckles, while Kibe remained still. Itagiba pointed at the bird, “What are you waiting for? Go get it!”
92616766456d.t: Itagiba dan Eiri sama-sama tergelak, sementara Kibe kekal kaku. Itagiba menunjuk ke arah burung itu, “Tunggu apa lagi? Pergi tangkap!”

938d7f3d1ef9.en: “I guess so? But that clearly was not a nari gel. Maybe—like an interface I never heard of before? Hey Kibe! What was that white fire?” Eiri turned up to the scientist for a formal answer.
938d7f3d1ef9.t: “Rasanya? Tapi itu jelas bukan nari gel. Mungkin—macam antara muka yang aku tak pernah dengar? Hei Kibe! Api putih tu apa?” Eiri berpaling kepada si saintis untuk jawapan rasmi.

9495df0115e7.en: Who’s that? Eiri approached the fat unconscious person, sunbathing in the middle of the room without a care in the world. With her gloved hands, she poked the person in his chubby cheeks. “You okay?”
9495df0115e7.t: Siapa tu? Eiri mendekati orang gemuk yang tidak sedarkan diri itu, berjemur di tengah-tengah bilik tanpa mempedulikan dunia. Dengan tangannya yang bersarung, dia mencucuk pipi tembam orang itu. “Kau okey?”

95f70502da59.en: “It’s gotta be!—I mean, Kibe launched a storm into his corpse, but then a white fire covered him up, and he transformed into this giant fanchaki.” Eiri’s smile grew ponderous, as she brought her yellow gloves to her attention, remembering how the white fire behaved like an ooze. “It was his body after all, so it has to be him, right?”
95f70502da59.t: “Mesti dia!—maksud aku, Kibe lepaskan ribut ke dalam mayat dia, tapi lepas tu api putih selubungi dia, dan dia bertukar jadi fanchaki gergasi ni.” Senyuman Eiri bertukar termenung, sambil dia membawa sarung tangan kuningnya ke depan mata, teringat bagaimana api putih itu berkelakuan seperti lendir. “Itu tubuh dia juga, jadi mesti dia, kan?”

9617dedf0ead.en: Chapter I subchapter 3: a man in a cape, the silver-haired man and the blonde girl gather around a large dead black bird in a castle courtyard.
9617dedf0ead.t: Bab I subbab 3: seorang lelaki berjubah, lelaki berambut perak dan gadis berambut perang berkumpul di sekeliling burung hitam besar yang mati di halaman istana.

979f28d184ed.en: Within a split second, the fanchaki's eyes lit up, and its body began flailing around, trying to escape the tight grip of Itagiba’s muscular hands.
979f28d184ed.t: Dalam sekelip mata, mata fanchaki itu bercahaya, dan tubuhnya mula meronta-ronta, cuba melepaskan diri dari cengkaman kuat tangan Itagiba yang berotot.

99942c94c617.en: “NO! We can’t. That’s Gabiro! Right, Kibe?” Eiri cut off Itagiba’s food-centric speech, staring at Kibe, but he remained with his head low, silent, as his hand comforted the dead-looking fanchaki.
99942c94c617.t: “JANGAN! Tak boleh. Itu Gabiro! Kan, Kibe?” Eiri memotong ucapan Itagiba yang berpusat pada makanan, merenung Kibe, tetapi Kibe kekal menunduk, diam, sementara tangannya mengusap fanchaki yang kelihatan mati itu.

9b23a6b19e59.en: A bit after what appeared to be peak brightness of the flame, a black feathery corpse, in the shape of a large chicken, began to emerge from within the white fire ooze, consuming it in the process, appearing exactly where Gabiro’s body once lay.
9b23a6b19e59.t: Tidak lama selepas api itu kelihatan mencapai kecerahan puncaknya, satu bangkai berbulu hitam, berbentuk seperti ayam besar, mula muncul dari dalam lendir api putih itu, menelannya dalam proses itu, muncul tepat di tempat tubuh Gabiro terbaring tadi.

9b6e0a9e752e.en: “No for Body Restore.” Pulling out the sigil ring with a logogram of a lightning bolt and a plus symbol, Kibe wore it on his right middle and ring fingers, and used his left hand to hold, and charge up the spell—making five white rings of fire appear around his left forearm. With his right hand, he pulled one of the nari stone chains from his pocket and started feeding its power into the spell, just like how Eiri had done it.
9b6e0a9e752e.t: “Tak, kalau guna Body Restore.” Mengeluarkan cincin sigil dengan logogram kilat dan simbol tambah, Kibe memakainya pada jari tengah dan jari manis kanannya, dan menggunakan tangan kirinya untuk memegang dan mengecas jampi itu—membuatkan lima gelang api putih muncul di sekeliling lengan bawah kirinya. Dengan tangan kanannya, dia menarik salah satu rantai batu nari dari poketnya dan mula menyuapkan kuasanya ke dalam jampi, sama seperti yang Eiri lakukan.

9c5a80373201.en: With a peck on Itagiba’s forearm, the bird found freedom, and took off running towards the distance. With an offbeat chuckling, wavering head, and zig-zag motion, the bird’s glorious freedom quickly ended when it suddenly collapsed into the ground, just like when someone claps or screams near a fainting goat.
9c5a80373201.t: Dengan satu patukan pada lengan bawah Itagiba, burung itu bebas, dan lari ke kejauhan. Dengan ketawa berkokok yang sumbang, kepala yang terhuyung-hayang dan gerakan zig-zag, kebebasan gemilang burung itu cepat berakhir apabila ia tiba-tiba rebah ke tanah, sama seperti apabila seseorang bertepuk tangan atau menjerit berhampiran kambing yang mudah pengsan.

9dcca0f5a5e2.en: The rustling noise of a vibrant city, filled with people, carriages, and animals of all kinds, all going about their daily business, reverberated from the other side of the stone wall. Eiri and Kibe stood by Gabiro’s corpse, quite bloodied, but no longer showing hints of being flattened against the not-so-soft terrain. The usually slightly salty, fishy air now had lingering scents of baked fish and smoked pork butt, giving hints that noon was approaching. However, there was also a lingering metallic smell of blood that did not curry favors in making either of them hungry.
9dcca0f5a5e2.t: Bunyi riuh sebuah kota yang meriah, penuh dengan orang, kereta kuda dan pelbagai jenis haiwan, semuanya sibuk dengan urusan harian masing-masing, bergema dari sebelah sana tembok batu. Eiri dan Kibe berdiri di sisi mayat Gabiro, berlumuran darah, tetapi tidak lagi menunjukkan tanda-tanda penyek di atas tanah yang tidak berapa lembut itu. Udara yang biasanya sedikit masin dan hanyir kini dibaluti bau ikan bakar dan punggung babi salai, petanda tengah hari semakin hampir. Namun, ada juga bau logam darah yang masih berlegar yang langsung tidak membantu membangkitkan selera mereka berdua.

a45118912de6.en: Nothing, except the rowdy noises of the populace outside coming in through the broken window. A stronger breeze blew through it, making a few glass shards fall in this silent room, like a cliché horror movie, but at last it brought in fresh, but slightly fishy humid air.
a45118912de6.t: Tiada apa-apa, kecuali bunyi riuh rendah orang ramai di luar yang masuk melalui tingkap yang pecah. Angin yang lebih kuat bertiup melaluinya, membuatkan beberapa serpihan kaca jatuh dalam bilik yang sunyi ini, seperti filem seram klise, tetapi akhirnya ia membawa masuk udara lembap yang segar, walaupun sedikit hanyir.

a49e0fad4125.en: “Kibe! Do something!” Eiri, taking a step back, waved her hands at Kibe to catch his attention. “KIBE!” she shouted, but there was no difference. It looked like Kibe was lost in his own world.
a49e0fad4125.t: “Kibe! Buat sesuatu!” Eiri, berundur selangkah, melambai-lambai tangannya ke arah Kibe untuk menarik perhatiannya. “KIBE!” dia menjerit, tetapi tiada bezanya. Kibe kelihatan seperti hanyut dalam dunianya sendiri.

a8468bd87c21.en: Kibe, still sitting on his hurting knees, froze up. His eyes looked dazzled as he saw the white fire slowly dance around, swallowing Gabiro.
a8468bd87c21.t: Kibe, masih duduk di atas lututnya yang sakit, terpaku. Matanya kelihatan terpukau melihat api putih itu perlahan-lahan menari-nari, menelan Gabiro.

a880d7ecd435.en: “Sora! What size are those?” Still picking up the glass, Eiri eyed the cutesy maid flying towards her.
a880d7ecd435.t: “Sora! Saiz apa tu?” Masih memungut kaca, Eiri mengerling pembantu rumah comel yang terbang ke arahnya.

ab189a2f7383.en: “DAMM! That’s huge! Are we gonna eat that?” A friendly sounding voice contrasted an alpha-looking male. He wore a fancy-looking tank top, covered in blue fish scales with gold accents, plus round sapphires on his white collar. His strong naked arms contrasted with the white of the cape he wore. He had a certain authoritarian air to him, but perhaps it was the way Eiri and Kibe were behaving towards him, rather than himself appearing as authoritative.
ab189a2f7383.t: “SIAL! Besarnya! Kita nak makan benda tu ke?” Suara yang kedengaran mesra itu berlawanan dengan rupa lelaki alfa empunya suara. Dia memakai baju tanpa lengan yang kelihatan mewah, dilitupi sisik ikan biru dengan hiasan emas, serta batu sapphire bulat pada kolar putihnya. Lengannya yang kuat dan terdedah kontras dengan jubah putih yang dipakainya. Dia memiliki aura berkuasa tertentu, tetapi mungkin itu kerana cara Eiri dan Kibe berkelakuan terhadapnya, dan bukannya kerana dirinya sendiri kelihatan berkuasa.

b181d6a51f5f.en: “I assume you’re on top of clothes, and such?” Itagiba scratched his pecked forearm skin, bringing his forearm close to his eyes. “Eh. Not bad.”
b181d6a51f5f.t: “Aku anggap kau dah uruskan pakaian dan sebagainya?” Itagiba menggaru kulit lengan bawahnya yang dipatuk, mendekatkan lengannya ke mata. “Eh. Boleh tahan.”

b54641ef7b20.en: “No need to—” Before Eiri could finish her sentence, Sora stepped on a pebble, and lost her balance, aggressively tilting forward. She held the straw bag like it was her baby, and with a few large steps, she seemed to recover from nearly eating dirt, only to ultimately bring herself back to top speed, putting herself at the same risk as before.
b54641ef7b20.t: “Tak perlu—” Sebelum Eiri sempat menghabiskan ayatnya, Sora terpijak batu kecil dan hilang keseimbangan, tertunduk ke depan dengan kuat. Dia memeluk beg jerami itu seperti bayinya, dan dengan beberapa langkah besar, dia nampaknya pulih daripada hampir tersembam ke tanah, hanya untuk kembali ke kelajuan maksimum, meletakkan dirinya dalam risiko yang sama seperti tadi.

b70baa74d04a.en: Kibe, no longer looking drunk, was pushed out of the room by Eiri, but as they neared the stairs, she instead went into another room, quickly checking the cupboards and cabinets inside what appeared to be a storage room. Holding himself at the top of the stairs, Kibe blurted out “You’re not coming?”
b70baa74d04a.t: Kibe, tidak lagi kelihatan mabuk, ditolak keluar dari bilik oleh Eiri, tetapi ketika mereka menghampiri tangga, Eiri sebaliknya masuk ke bilik lain, memeriksa almari dan kabinet dengan pantas di dalam sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bilik stor. Berpaut di puncak tangga, Kibe terlepas cakap “Kau tak ikut?”

b95519f571fe.en: More people gathered to see what was going on, with some spotting Eiri’s head peeking through the glass.
b95519f571fe.t: Lebih ramai orang berkumpul untuk melihat apa yang berlaku, dengan sesetengahnya ternampak kepala Eiri yang menjenguk melalui kaca.

c2c4d48bf72d.en: “Arrggghhhh'' A painful gurgle breath came out of Kibe, as the pupils of his eyes contracted tightly. Looking as if he had just run a marathon, he remained still, looking at Eiri’s worried green eyes. “What are you doing in my room?” he tiredly blurted out, choking up, and spitting leftover blood.
c2c4d48bf72d.t: “Arrggghhhh'' Nafas berdeguk yang menyakitkan keluar daripada Kibe, ketika anak matanya mengecut ketat. Kelihatan seperti baru habis berlari maraton, dia kekal kaku, memandang mata hijau Eiri yang risau. “Apa kau buat dalam bilik aku?” dia terlepas cakap dengan letih, tercekik, dan meludahkan sisa darah.

ca188e0f74cd.en: Another gust of wind rushed by, nearly ripping Eiri’s blue headdress away. Holding onto it, she noticed a few people in the surrounding buildings, some of whom were taller than the castle walls, peeking towards the base of the tower she was in. Bending her head down, she saw a backdrop of the same lusty green vegetation at the feet of the tower she was in, but its lively greenish hue contrasted the bright vivid red blood oozing from the flattened old gentleman, resembling Gabiro. “Ohhh—this is bad.”
ca188e0f74cd.t: Satu lagi tiupan angin menerpa, hampir merentap hiasan kepala biru Eiri. Sambil memegangnya, dia perasan beberapa orang di bangunan sekeliling, sesetengahnya lebih tinggi daripada tembok istana, mengintai ke arah kaki menara tempat dia berada. Menundukkan kepala, dia nampak latar tumbuhan hijau subur yang sama di kaki menara itu, tetapi warna kehijauannya yang meriah bertentangan dengan darah merah terang yang meleleh daripada seorang lelaki tua yang sudah penyek, menyerupai Gabiro. “Ohhh—teruk ni.”

cb6d475b69b4.en: Eiri took the mostly empty jar away from his mouth, “It’s not that bad. Stop it!”
cb6d475b69b4.t: Eiri menjauhkan balang yang hampir kosong itu dari mulutnya, “Tak teruk sangat pun. Sudahlah!”

cbb5fae2d974.en: Eiri, meanwhile, wore her yellow glove again, then handed the two rings she had to Kibe. “You came back from there like two weeks ago, on the fourth! Now get up! C’mon! Gabiro is really, really dead!” She extended her gloved hand towards him.
cbb5fae2d974.t: Eiri, sementara itu, memakai semula sarung tangan kuningnya, lalu menghulurkan dua cincin yang dipegangnya kepada Kibe. “Kau balik dari sana macam dua minggu lepas, pada hari keempat! Sekarang bangun! Cepatlah! Gabiro betul-betul, betul-betul dah mati!” Dia menghulurkan tangannya yang bersarung ke arahnya.

ce095145307c.en: “I guess not—” Kibe shivered again as another gust of air blew through his blood-soaked uniform, making him nearly release the spell. He stiffed himself in response, waiting for Eiri to say something, but her eyes were still focused on the bloodthirsty glass instead.
ce095145307c.t: “Tak kot—” Kibe menggigil lagi apabila satu lagi tiupan angin menembusi seragamnya yang basah dengan darah, hampir membuatkan dia melepaskan jampi itu. Dia menegangkan badannya sebagai tindak balas, menunggu Eiri berkata sesuatu, tetapi mata Eiri masih tertumpu pada kaca yang dahagakan darah itu.

cf6162bc8e3b.en: Meanwhile, in the background of the city, a voice, from a deep, smooth sounding old male, like a cowboy in a cigarette advertisement, sounded slightly strained as it spoke above everyone else's voices. Amidst the shout, the words “Juicy Fanchaki”, and “Tony’s Meatery!” reached Eiri and Kibe’s ears.
cf6162bc8e3b.t: Sementara itu, di latar belakang kota, satu suara lelaki tua yang dalam dan lunak, seperti koboi dalam iklan rokok, kedengaran sedikit tegang ketika ia bercakap mengatasi suara orang lain. Di tengah-tengah laungan itu, perkataan “Juicy Fanchaki”, dan “Tony’s Meatery!” sampai ke telinga Eiri dan Kibe.

cfaeefc2aaba.en: “King-maid!” a cute, upbeat, but really fast girly voice came from afar, interrupting the conversation. A small maid in black and blue, about Eiri’s shoulder height, with fiery red hair, bright cyan eyes, and a cutesy small mouth, complemented by small, but sharp protruding canine teeth from her lower jaw, came running towards Eiri. Her cutesy slender legs were walking so fast that it appeared she was hovering above ground, while a straw bag flopped to her side, nearly spilling its contents as if she was running for her dear life.
cfaeefc2aaba.t: “King-maid!” suara gadis yang comel, ceria, tetapi sangat laju kedengaran dari jauh, memotong perbualan. Seorang pembantu rumah kecil berpakaian hitam dan biru, kira-kira separas bahu Eiri, dengan rambut merah menyala, mata biru kehijauan yang terang, dan mulut kecil yang comel, dilengkapi gigi taring kecil tetapi tajam yang tersembul dari rahang bawahnya, datang berlari ke arah Eiri. Kakinya yang ramping dan comel melangkah begitu laju sehingga dia kelihatan seperti melayang di atas tanah, sementara beg jerami terhayun di sisinya, hampir menumpahkan isinya seolah-olah dia berlari menyelamatkan nyawa.

d092cf2ad20f.en: Itagiba and Eiri exchanged glances, only for Itagiba to shrug as well.
d092cf2ad20f.t: Itagiba dan Eiri berbalas pandangan, hanya untuk Itagiba turut mengangkat bahu.

d22d301a9f77.en: “Oookay—” Eiri's troubled eyes glanced at the undisturbed-looking Itagiba. They never said that in the meeting. Seeing Kibe release the spell with no effect on the bird, Eiri picked up the glass jar with leftover black honey off the ground and approached the bird. “Can you please hold its pecker open?”
d22d301a9f77.t: “Okeeey—” Mata Eiri yang bermasalah mengerling Itagiba yang kelihatan tidak terganggu. Mereka tak pernah cakap macam tu dalam mesyuarat. Melihat Kibe melepaskan jampi itu tanpa kesan pada burung tersebut, Eiri memungut balang kaca berisi sisa madu hitam dari tanah dan mendekati burung itu. “Boleh tolong pegang paruh dia terbuka?”

d3cbba88d1f7.en: “King-maid! I’m sorry! Did I forget the size? I got Sanbi Average! I’m sorry!” A red blush arose in the maid’s face, speaking so quickly it looked like she was trying to rap, but without a solid beat. As she finished her freestyle, she crouched down, letting go of her straw bag, and going after one of the glass shards.
d3cbba88d1f7.t: “King-maid! Maaf! Saya terlupa saiz ke? Saya ambil Purata Sanbi! Maaf!” Wajah pembantu rumah itu merah padam, bercakap begitu laju sehingga dia kelihatan seperti cuba ber-rap, tetapi tanpa rentak yang kukuh. Sebaik sahaja dia habis ber-rap bebas, dia mencangkung, melepaskan beg jeraminya, dan mengejar salah satu serpihan kaca.

d5879eb5c8b9.en: Her eyes glanced through a drawer neatly packed full of sigil rings—a double ring composed of a frontal plate with two drawn squares, with each square containing a logogram inside. Eiri’s hand reached out to two specific rings; one had the name Body Restore written on the back plate, with two logograms—an Egyptian-like hieroglyph on the faceplate. The first was of a body, and the second was a circle with a broken round piece being glued back together. The second sigil ring had a name of Storm Create, also containing two logograms: a lightning bolt and a plus sign.
d5879eb5c8b9.t: Matanya meninjau sebuah laci yang tersusun rapi penuh dengan cincin sigil—cincin berkembar yang terdiri daripada plat hadapan dengan dua segi empat dilukis, dan setiap segi empat mengandungi satu logogram. Tangan Eiri mencapai dua cincin tertentu; satu tertulis nama Body Restore pada plat belakang, dengan dua logogram—hieroglif seperti Mesir pada plat mukanya. Yang pertama ialah sebuah tubuh, dan yang kedua ialah bulatan dengan satu kepingan bulat yang pecah sedang dicantum semula. Cincin sigil kedua bernama Storm Create, juga mengandungi dua logogram: kilat dan tanda tambah.

d5fbccbbc44c.en: Chapter I subchapter 2: the silver-haired man kneels over a bloodied body in a garden while the blonde girl stands with arms crossed.
d5fbccbbc44c.t: Bab I subbab 2: lelaki berambut perak melutut di sisi tubuh berlumuran darah di sebuah taman sementara gadis berambut perang berdiri sambil memeluk tubuh.

d8896553cbcd.en: Kibe shrugged with his hands up in the air, turning back towards the stairs. Carefully holding himself in the blue handrails, he took his sweet time going down, leaving bloodied handprints which would surely make whoever has to clean it very happy—or not.
d8896553cbcd.t: Kibe mengangkat bahu dengan tangan ke udara, berpaling semula ke arah tangga. Berpaut dengan berhati-hati pada pemegang tangga biru, dia mengambil masa sesuka hati untuk turun, meninggalkan kesan tapak tangan berdarah yang pasti akan membuatkan sesiapa yang terpaksa membersihkannya sangat gembira—atau tidak.

dc40666985c7.en: Chapter I subchapter 1: a shocked blonde girl in a blue dress looks at a man lying on a table in a misty room.
dc40666985c7.t: Bab I subbab 1: seorang gadis berambut perang bergaun biru yang terkejut memandang seorang lelaki terbaring di atas meja dalam bilik berkabus.

de906b8346ce.en: Eiri extended her hand, making a stop sign “NO! That’s more than enough!” Suddenly crouching, she began picking up the glass shards surrounding him. “Don’t release it either! He’s gonna start convulsing with that much!”
de906b8346ce.t: Eiri menghulurkan tangannya, membuat isyarat berhenti “JANGAN! Itu dah lebih daripada cukup!” Tiba-tiba mencangkung, dia mula memungut serpihan kaca di sekeliling Gabiro. “Jangan lepaskan lagi! Dia akan mula kejang dengan sebanyak tu!”

e00e21c6ec40.en: Gabiro’s entire body convulsed just like a spoiled child throwing a fit on the floor after being told “no” for bringing candy to the checkout line. Tiny shards of glass dug into Gabiro’s skin, making it look like a chicken breast being dipped in breading, except it did not look appetizing. His chest, charred from the powerful lightning spell, released an eau-de-toilette of charred crispy skin, giving the corpse an appearance of more-dead-than-before fashionable look.
e00e21c6ec40.t: Seluruh tubuh Gabiro kejang seperti budak manja yang mengamuk di lantai selepas dilarang membawa gula-gula ke kaunter bayaran. Serpihan kaca kecil terbenam ke dalam kulit Gabiro, membuatkannya kelihatan seperti dada ayam yang dicelup dalam tepung roti, cuma ia tidak kelihatan menyelerakan. Dadanya, hangus akibat jampi kilat yang kuat, mengeluarkan wangian kulit rangup yang hangus, memberikan mayat itu rupa bergaya yang lebih-mati-daripada-tadi.

e1e6f9eedd9f.en: A slow twitch randomly surged across his body, progressing into faster ones. Sounds of bones rubbing against each other echoed into Eiri’s ear, serving as some sort of macabre rhythm for the melody of juicy flesh and tendons moving about. Kibe’s head, still lifeless, started to move somewhat back upright, reaching a “not-so-broken” appearance.
e1e6f9eedd9f.t: Satu kedutan perlahan menjalar secara rawak ke seluruh tubuhnya, lalu menjadi semakin pantas. Bunyi tulang bergeseran sesama sendiri bergema di telinga Eiri, menjadi semacam rentak ngeri bagi melodi daging berair dan urat yang bergerak-gerak. Kepala Kibe, masih tidak bernyawa, mula bergerak kembali tegak sedikit demi sedikit, sehingga kelihatan “tidaklah patah sangat”.

e77e1a798146.en: “Kibe?” Eiri quickly delegated the answer. “—are you even listening?”
e77e1a798146.t: “Kibe?” Eiri pantas melemparkan soalan itu. “—kau dengar ke tak?”

e8e2d4682403.en: No answer. Kibe remained mouth open, still sitting on his knees as he kept watching the flame do its thing, the ooze grew closer towards him, stopping about one centimeter away from him.
e8e2d4682403.t: Tiada jawapan. Kibe kekal ternganga, masih duduk di atas lututnya sambil terus memerhati api itu membuat kerjanya, lendir itu semakin menghampirinya, berhenti kira-kira satu sentimeter darinya.

e9e21173036a.en: That girl needs to chill out. Eiri placed the last large piece of glass in the chunk, and stood up. Adjusting her skirt, she looked around for peeping eyes from the curious populace, only to spot a single set of eyes: the same older, nearly balding male, still fervently watching over them, now chowing down what appeared to be a tube of some sort of cream. “Fine! Release slowly.” Crossing her arms, she saw Gabiro’s peaceful semblance turn into a twitching, and teeth-clicking fest when a bolt of lightning zapped from Kibe’s palm into his chest.
e9e21173036a.t: Budak tu kena bertenang sikit. Eiri meletakkan kepingan kaca besar terakhir ke dalam timbunan, lalu berdiri. Membetulkan skirtnya, dia memandang sekeliling mencari mata-mata yang mengintai dari orang ramai yang ingin tahu, hanya untuk ternampak sepasang mata: lelaki tua yang hampir botak tadi, masih memerhati mereka dengan bersungguh-sungguh, kini melahap sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti setiub krim. “Okey! Lepaskan perlahan-lahan.” Memeluk tubuh, dia melihat wajah Gabiro yang tenang bertukar menjadi pesta kekejangan dan gigi berketap apabila satu panahan kilat menyambar dari tapak tangan Kibe ke dadanya.

ec04d72aaf7d.en: Eiri picked up the glass shard Sora was after, and dropped it in the pile. “No, that was me who told you the wrong size apparently. Alright, go—go—go!” Shooing the cutesy maid away, she looked at Sora, nearly jumping away, instead of just standing up normally.
ec04d72aaf7d.t: Eiri memungut serpihan kaca yang dikejar Sora, dan menjatuhkannya ke dalam timbunan. “Tak, nampaknya aku yang bagi tahu kau saiz yang salah. Okey, pergi—pergi—pergi!” Menghalau pembantu rumah comel itu, dia melihat Sora hampir melompat pergi, bukannya bangun seperti biasa.

edaf8b602b9d.en: Appearing as if he had just heard the news of a dead loved one, Itagiba’s eyes lost all of its alpha-male glimmer. “Then what was that white fire for?”
edaf8b602b9d.t: Seolah-olah baru mendengar berita kematian orang tersayang, mata Itagiba hilang seluruh kilauan lelaki alfanya. “Habis tu api putih tadi untuk apa?”

ee40f3e3959a.en: Meanwhile, the charred skin on Gabiro’s chest began healing itself with new, relatively speaking, skin; it looked just as old as the rest of his body as it emerged from around the injury, slowly, but visibly making progress towards its nucleus.
ee40f3e3959a.t: Sementara itu, kulit hangus di dada Gabiro mula memulihkan dirinya dengan kulit yang, secara relatifnya, baharu; ia kelihatan sama tua dengan bahagian lain tubuhnya ketika ia tumbuh dari sekeliling luka, perlahan-lahan, tetapi jelas bergerak ke arah pusatnya.

f298d12c9ad5.en: Eiri chuck another glass. “Sure—then why were you two—”
f298d12c9ad5.t: Eiri mencampak satu lagi kaca. “Yalah—habis tu kenapa korang berdua—”

f45e955c7904.en: Kibe looked around the room aimlessly, as if he did not believe the words that came out of Eiri. “But I am in Waterfall! My bed is—” His eyes focused on the taint belonging to a body in the center of the room, sunbathing atop a table. Kibe appeared to be taken aback, appearing to pause to see if it was a taint he recognized.
f45e955c7904.t: Kibe memandang sekeliling bilik tanpa arah, seolah-olah tidak percaya kata-kata yang keluar daripada Eiri. “Tapi aku kat Waterfall! Katil aku—” Matanya tertumpu pada celah kangkang milik satu tubuh di tengah-tengah bilik, berjemur di atas meja. Kibe kelihatan tergamam, seolah-olah berhenti sejenak untuk melihat sama ada itu celah kangkang yang dia kenali.

f76c051194e0.en: Eiri stood up, cleaning her hand on a cloth she pulled from a nearby drawer, “What are you talking about?” One of Eiri’s brow twitched up. “What were you two doing anyway? Gabiro is dead!”
f76c051194e0.t: Eiri bangun, membersihkan tangannya pada sehelai kain yang dia tarik dari laci berdekatan, “Apa kau merepek ni?” Salah satu kening Eiri terangkat. “Apa yang korang berdua buat sebenarnya? Gabiro dah mati!”

f83c0b9bf2e9.en: “You don’t?” Kibe shrugged. “That’s a dumb question! That’s what the nari gel interface is for!” Kibe’s tone sounded somewhat rude, especially for someone just sitting there, not even helping pick up the glass.
f83c0b9bf2e9.t: “Tak boleh?” Kibe mengangkat bahu. “Soalan bodoh! Sebab itulah adanya antara muka nari gel!” Nada Kibe kedengaran agak biadab, terutamanya untuk seseorang yang cuma duduk di situ, tidak menolong memungut kaca pun.

f9715bb09d30.en: Itagiba smiled, helping Kibe up. With a cheery mood, he tapped his back. “Well, you’re the courtroom scientist now—” his voice went deeper, and his face straight, “—so figure this shit out, and get me what Maiara wanted by tomorrow morning.”
f9715bb09d30.t: Itagiba tersenyum, membantu Kibe bangun. Dengan mood ceria, dia menepuk belakangnya. “Nah, kau saintis istana sekarang—” suaranya menjadi lebih garau, dan wajahnya serius, “—jadi selesaikan benda celaka ni, dan dapatkan apa yang Maiara nak sebelum esok pagi.”
